summary.short: Amends Iowa Code § 728.12(3) to make it unlawful to knowingly purchase or possess a visual depiction of a minor engaged in a prohibited sexual act or its simulation; the provided text states no effective date.
summary.long: The Act amends Iowa Code § 728.12, subsection 3 (Code 2024), on sexual exploitation of minors. Paragraph a makes it unlawful to knowingly purchase or possess a visual depiction of a minor engaging in a prohibited sexual act or the simulation of a prohibited sexual act. Paragraph b provides that a depiction containing pictorial representations of different minors is prosecuted as a separate offense for each different minor, while multiple depictions of the same minor are one offense. Paragraph c makes a violation a class D felony for a first offense and a class C felony for a second or subsequent offense. Paragraph d defines a second or subsequent offense as one preceded by a conviction or deferred judgment under this subsection, or a conviction or deferred judgment in another jurisdiction. The title refers to creating, adapting or modifying a visual depiction to give the appearance that an identifiable minor is engaged in a prohibited sexual act, but the supplied text contains no provision on those acts. The text states no effective date.
